title: Jubilant Norwegian Cod Broth
description: A hearty, comforting Norwegian-inspired cod broth made with jubilant spices.
instructions: Heat 2 cups of water in a large pot over medium heat.
Add the chopped onion, sliced carrots, and chopped celery. Cook until the vegetables are tender, about 5-7 minutes.
Add the cod fillets, jubilant spice mix, and vegetable broth to the pot.
Bring the mixture to a boil, then reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, for 8-10 minutes or until the cod is cooked through.
Remove the pot from the heat and let it cool slightly.
Serve the cod and broth hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
